paragraphs: A language-independent guide to designing a booking system through relationships, responsibility boundaries, state models and time constraints.
bullets: Separated Site, Auth, Booking and Payment responsibilities; explained identity, signing/verification, localized users, resource ownership, listings and frozen booking terms.

Modeled booking lifecycles and overlapping Operation, Reserved and Historical state families. Distinguished trip intervals from state lifespans, State Time Constraints from calendar occupancy, and live payment holds from non-reserving proposals.

Derived availability from offered time minus live allocations and checked the whole requested interval for bookability. Separated Booking-owned cancellation/refund entitlement from Payment execution and verified financial outcomes.

The first edition establishes the architecture. Two further editions are planned: 2nd Edition - Modules Implementation, followed by 3rd Edition - Infrastructure, covering runtime topology, deployment and operations.
